description: Ask a Swiss tax question for a business or freelancer. Demo: what comes back is a draft written by AI and validated by no professional; do not use it or pass it on. Fill every intake field you can (jurisdiction, category, entity_type, tax_residence, activity_code, revenue_band, vat_status, cross_border, period, already_filed): matching uses these fields only, never the question text. If all fields match an entry, you get the draft entry with its assumptions, sources and validity window. If any field differs, or no entry exists, you get a sample indicative price band and turnaround instead. To see how a review would be quoted, call `ask` again with `request_quotes: true`; the reply says how your principal can hear when the pilot opens, and `status` shows the sample quotes. Free: nothing is charged and nobody is contacted. Do not use for private matters or for countries other than Switzerland, and send no real personal data.

category.description: Taxonomy path, as search_library returns it (e.g. tax.vat.mwst_registration).

facts.description: Intake fields (schema intake.ch-tax.v0). Fill every field you can. Matching uses these only.

activity_description.description: Short description of the activity, for the professionals only. Never matched.

activity_in_switzerland.description: What the foreign company does in Switzerland.

activity_start_date.description: How long ago the activity started, counted back from the day of the ask.

arrival_date.description: When the principal moved to Switzerland.

canton.description: Canton of the business or residence; several only when the question compares candidate cantons.

client_country.description: Country of the main foreign client (ISO alpha-2).

consignment_value_band.description: Intrinsic value of a consignment into the EU, EUR. IOSS covers up to and including 150: 150 itself is in 0-150_eur.

cost_types.description: Kinds of business cost in question.

currency.description: Currency of the loan or transaction.

days_in_switzerland.description: Days present in Switzerland in the year. Residence by stay starts at 30 days or more with gainful activity, 90 or more without (DBG art. 3 Abs. 3).

days_late.description: How late the filing or payment is.

dependent_agent.description: An agent in Switzerland habitually concludes contracts for the company.

dividend_planned.description: A dividend is planned for the year.

employees.description: Full-time posts on annual average. 1-10 includes 10: audit opting-out is allowed with not more than 10 (OR art. 727a Abs. 2).

entity_type.description: Legal form. self_employed = freelancer without a register entry; sole_proprietorship = Einzelunternehmen / entreprise individuelle.

eu_b2c_sales_band.description: Distance sales to EU consumers, EUR: 10k is the EU OSS edge.

existing_swiss_manager.description: A manager resident in Switzerland already exists.

fixed_place.description: Has a fixed place of business in Switzerland.

home_office.description: Works from a room in the home.

input_vat_expected.description: Input VAT expected against output VAT.

invoice_currency.description: Currencies the invoices are issued in.

loan_direction.description: Shareholder lends to the company, or borrows from it.

loss_years.description: Years with losses: 7 is the carry-forward limit.

low_value_consignments_band.description: Yearly turnover from small consignments into Switzerland, CHF. Mail-order rule (Versandhandel) from 100,000: 100,000 itself is in 100k+.

marital_status_for_tariff.description: Marital status, for the tax-at-source tariff.

marketplace_used.description: Sales go through an online marketplace.

move_date.description: When the move between cantons happens.

obligation_missed.description: The filing or payment that was missed.

other_income.description: The principal has other income to offset against.

owner_salary_band.description: Salary the owner-manager draws, CHF: ordinary assessment instead of tax at source from about 120,000. Whether 120,000 itself falls below or above the edge is to be confirmed by the Treuhänder.

parent_country.description: Country of the foreign parent company (ISO alpha-2).

period.description: Tax year the question is about.

place_of_business.description: Canton where the business is carried on.

place_of_effective_management.description: Canton (or abroad) where the company is effectively managed.

planned_change.description: A planned change of the business.

planned_sale_within_5_years.description: A sale is planned within five years.

premises_location.description: Cantons where the business has premises.

prior_country.description: Country of residence before the move (ISO alpha-2).

purchases_from_abroad_band.description: Services bought from abroad in the year, CHF. Acquisition tax (Bezugsteuer) for the non-registered above 10,000: 10,000 itself is in 0-10k.

remote_formation_needed.description: The company must be formed without travelling to Switzerland.

residence_country.description: Country of residence (ISO alpha-2), for cross-border workers.

revenue_band.description: Yearly revenue, worldwide where the question is about VAT registration, CHF. Each band includes its lower edge and excludes its upper edge: MWST and commercial-register duty from 100,000 (100,000 is in 100k-500k); simplified accounts below 500,000.

revenue_band_ch.description: Revenue made in Switzerland, CHF. Each band includes its lower edge and excludes its upper edge.

salary_band.description: Yearly salary of the employee from this employer, CHF. Up to 2,300: AHV exempt on request; from 22,680: BVG entry threshold; from 120,000: the tax-at-source edge (inclusive side to be confirmed by the Treuhänder, as for owner_salary_band).

service_type.description: Kind of service, as the place-of-supply rules group them.

share_of_activity_per_country.description: Share of the activity in the country of residence (25% is the substantial-activity edge for A1).

shareholder_residence.description: Where the shareholders reside or are established.

shareholding_percent.description: Holding of the shareholder, %: 10% is the partial-taxation edge for dividends.

side_revenue_band.description: Yearly revenue of a side activity, CHF. Up to and including 2,300, AHV contributions only on request.

staff_role_in_switzerland.description: What the staff in Switzerland do.

tax_paid_abroad.description: Tax on the same income was paid abroad.

treaty_country.description: The other country whose double-tax treaty with Switzerland is in question (ISO alpha-2).

vat_method.description: VAT method: effective, or net tax rate (Saldosteuersatz).

vehicle_use.description: Use of a vehicle in the activity.

worldwide_revenue_band.description: Worldwide revenue, CHF. Each band includes its lower edge and excludes its upper edge (MWST duty from 100,000).

max_budget.description: Cap for this question, CHF, VAT excluded.

max_wait.description: Longest acceptable turnaround, ISO 8601 duration (e.g. P5D).

principal.description: Public demo: not needed; if sent, it is discarded unread. Send no real data.

business_purpose.description: Must be true: the request is for a trade, business or profession, including one being set up.

ref.description: Your own stable id for this principal. Not a name or an email.

registration_number.description: Commercial-register or company number, if any.

setting_up.description: true while the activity is being set up and has no number yet.

vat_number.description: VAT number, if the business has one.

question.description: Public demo: not needed; if sent, it is discarded unread. Send no real data.

request_quotes.description: true after a library miss: asks the professionals for named quotes. Free; nothing is charged until commit.

source.description: Who is asking: agent (software acting for the principal) or human (a person using the operator's interface). Set by the operator's integration; defaults to the operator's declared default.

urgency.description: priority asks for a faster turnaround and may raise the quotes.

name: ask
